// OFFICE PRODUCTIVITY UTILITIES

> OCR PDF UTILITIES

MATCHING RECORDS: 3

  • Stirling-PDF:
    A powerful, open-source (GPL-3.0) web-based PDF manipulation suite that runs entirely locally via Docker or local hosting with zero telemetry.
  • PDF24 Creator & Tools:
    A completely free, feature-complete PDF toolkit offered both as a web utility and as an installable Windows desktop app (PDF24 Creator) that processes all PDF operations 100% locally on your machine.
  • Tesseract OCR:
    An open-source optical character recognition engine that runs 100% locally on your own hardware to extract text from images and scanned documents completely offline.
